Asian Games: Vithya Breaks National Record As Parul Bags Double Bronze

Indian athletes Vithya Ramraj and Parul Chaudhary reflected on their medal-winning performances at the Asian Games, with both runners adding to their medal tally at the continental sporting event. [2]

Esports was first introduced as a demonstration sport at the 2018 Jakarta-Palembang Asian Games before becoming an official medal event at the 2022 Hangzhou Games. [1]

The performance also took Vithya's Asian Games medal tally to five. [2]

Asian Games 2026: Athletics gold streak survives as India's medal mix changes

India's athletics gold streak survived at the Asian Games, but the 2026 campaign was a marked shift from Hangzhou. [3]
